subtitle: Tender roast beef with Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes, seasonal vegetables and gravy, suited to diners wanting a traditional Sunday meal.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons roast beef typically costs {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with Yorkshire pudding, roasted potatoes, seasonal vegetables and meat gravy. Available on Sundays only, it combines tender beef with crisp and fluffy accompaniments. Prices vary by pub, so check the local menu and availability before making a special trip.

taste:
This roast centres on tender beef and deep, savoury flavour, with crisp accompaniments giving the plate some contrast. The slices are described as generous, while the rich, dark meat gravy ties the beef, potatoes and Yorkshire pudding together. It is a traditional combination rather than a roast built around unusual additions.

The potatoes offer a golden crunch outside and a fluffy texture within. Alongside them, the tall Yorkshire pudding starts crisp, with gravy soaking into it as you eat. Seasonal vegetables complete the plate without changing its emphasis on beef and gravy. For diners who value contrasting textures, the tender meat, crisp pudding and fluffy potatoes are the main draw.

Roast Chicken Breast and Roast Pork are the named meat alternatives to compare before ordering. Vegetarian Wellington and Vegan Wellington provide other choices in the same section. The useful value check is the complete plate and your preferred main, not simply the headline price.

dietaryGuidance:
Roast beef is not a vegetarian or vegan choice, and our data lists no dietary tags for this dish. The recorded allergens are cereals containing gluten, eggs and milk. Diners avoiding any of these should [check the current allergen](/allergen-information) information with the pub before ordering.

The data does not identify which individual components contain each allergen, so removing an accompaniment is not enough to establish suitability. Swaps can also change the allergens present. Vegetarian Wellington and Vegan Wellington are tagged alternatives, but their allergen information needs checking separately.
